title: Meta’s AI Chief Warns Against ‘Handover Of Society To AI’—Frustrating Social Media Users Who Want Solutions
summary: Meta’s chief AI officer Alexandr Wang issued a warning on X about a “handover of society to AI,” urging the industry to take “meaningfully different actions”—though some social media users felt he did not offer real solutions.
